messages.text: I was trying to install the Harlo OS on my Hammer Miner DC02 I purchased from you but evidently the screen is locked and will not accept the new firmware. Is there an option for loading Harlo OS, as I see it's an option for your current Hammer Miner DC02.
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner DC02
Handed to the team · Firmware compatibility and unlock procedure for the DC02 are not in the product

Short answer: I don't want to guess on this one. The D.02 is our Scrypt unit, and the catalog doesn't spell out whether Harlo OS loads on the version you have or how the locked screen gets released, so JD on our hardware side is picking it up.

Two things that help him: which DC02 you have (US or EU plug) and whether the unit was ever overclocked or reflashed before.

He's back Monday at 10am Eastern and replies by email. What address should it go to?
US plug and no, running as received from HeliumDeploy.

Good, that's the clean case: US plug, stock firmware, nothing touched. That's on the note for JD.

I still need an email to send his answer to, since we're offline until Monday at 10am Eastern. What's the best address for you?

Got it, Gary, I've put (email hidden) on the note. JD picks this up Monday at 10am Eastern and replies there, so nothing to wait around for.

A copy of this conversation also lands in that inbox once we're done here, and you can reply straight to it if anything else comes up.
